task: Add a read-only CLI report that shows a story milestone ledger as a grouped progress table with sub-objective detail.
outcome: When the user runs `lattice milestone_status --storyId=B-demo`, the terminal shows `Milestone Status — B-demo`, then a Completed section, a Current section with expanded sub-objectives/evidence/risks/next action, and a Remaining section; the output explicitly says read-only and does not claim it advanced the story.
facts: ProofStory already has milestone_ledger_set/add/get and stores milestone-ledger.json.
The current milestone ledger is an intent coverage contract, not an executor state machine or separate storage layer.
Existing checklist items carry verificationIntent and verificationEvidence that can be projected into report rows.
Read-only status commands use unsupported mutation flags to fail closed in command-catalog.ts.
The user specifically wants every milestone and the active milestone details visible after milestone or sub-objective status changes.
V1 will not have future completion-writer transition artifacts; it must degrade gracefully and show unavailable transition detail as a limitation.
constraints: Do not create a second milestone storage system.
Do not run commands, write evidence, launch reviewers, or advance phases from milestone_status.
Do not modify the existing dirty README.md change from main.
Keep V1 report truthful when ledger detail is missing: report missing detail rather than inventing it.
